item.title: Attacks on Kashmiris Outside J&K Unacceptable, Says CM Omar Abdullah
item.description: JAMMU: Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah on Thursday strongly condemned attacks on people from Kashmir in various parts of the country, including Himachal Pradesh, terming such incidents “unacceptable” and calling for their immediate prevention. He asserted that his government would intervene wherever required to ensure the safety of Kashmiris outside the Union Territory. [...]

item.description: JAMMU: Strengthening access to advanced paediatric heart care in Jammu and Kashmir, SMVD Narayana Superspeciality Hospital organised a specialised Free Paediatric Cardiology Camp today at its Multispeciality Clinic in Gandhi Nagar, Jammu.
